scope: Exact individual records from the full slide/presentation/OPC/package/resource owner-module relevance superset. Parameter variants and BDD examples are retained separately. Import is an additional operation, not a replacement for those original model cases. All canonical rows outside this owner-module subset remain unchanged; preservation of chart/text/table/drawing payloads does not claim their editing APIs.
notice: upstream-license-notice.txt; test-case-map-notice.txt. No source test bodies or assets copied; research identities and evidence pointers only.

language_security_mapping.operation_names: importSlides and camelCase operation options are separate from the retained neutral snake_case live-model spellings (J01).
language_security_mapping.ownership: Explicit cross-document import remaps graph ownership; this does not enable cross-owner model assignment (J02).
language_security_mapping.positions: sourceSlides and position are one-based operation positions. Live collection lookup remains zero-based with per-collection bounds/negative/slice rules (J03).
language_security_mapping.values: Canvas EMUs are exact bounded integers; null and absence are not falsy values. No geometry rescaling is implied (J05).
language_security_mapping.io: Always-async admitted byte inputs or explicitly authorized VFS paths, context limits and cancellation. No implicit host access, network, native process, font lookup or external-link activation (J06/J07).
language_security_mapping.errors: Stable domain errors and shared CLI exit mappings apply; unsupported theme/notes-reference conversions remain visible rather than approximated (J08).
language_security_mapping.public_surface: Inherited properties, enum symbols, helpers and underscore-prefixed public types remain in the canonical API inventory; this operation claims none of them as completed (J01-J04).

documentation_drift.finding: Format section 6.4 requires themePolicy while section 9 and the current user request require source appearance by default.
documentation_drift.resolution: This operation defaults themePolicy to source under the latest user instruction. Destination theme remapping is explicitly unsupported; no placeholder-style flattening is performed.

documentation_drift.resolution: Those documents describe the pinned historical baseline. This supplemental file records only the bounded import operation; historical statements are not changed into whole-API completion claims.

notes_master_registration.finding: The notes master list permits zero or one entry, not an unbounded list. A conflicting source master cannot be registered beside an existing distinct destination master.

notes_master_registration.decision: Reuse only after proven equivalent full closure; otherwise reject the incompatible import atomically. A destination without a notes master can register the copied source notes master. The copied notes slide must still relate to that master and the copied slide.
notes_master_registration.implemented_boundary: Conservative rejection when any imported notes master meets an existing destination notes-master relationship; equivalent-master reuse is not implemented. Resources receive separate names; no deduplication is claimed.
